report_rule: Full-stream hits/proposals per setting is descriptive. Formal 95% retention intervals condition on the recomputed smoke prefix (batches 0-4, h0 hits) and use only later proposals: a setting ending at its proposal budget gets Clopper-Pearson on (suffix hits, suffix proposals); a setting ending at the hit stop gets the exact negative-binomial interval from n*, the suffix position of its (HIT_STOP - h0)-th suffix hit: [BetaInv(0.025; c, n*-c+1), BetaInv(0.975; c, n*-c)], c = HIT_STOP - h0. Together these are exact for each setting's declared curtailed design (outcomes ordered by n* when stopped, else by suffix hits); no coverage is claimed conditional on the subset of settings that completed. Censored, failed or interrupted settings get no formal interval: a Clopper-Pearson sensitivity interval on their committed suffix, labelled as assuming non-informative censoring. Time: observed CPU through the crossing batch for hit-stopped settings; rate-based projections to 2,000 for the others, labelled projections; zero hits give an upper retention bound and an unresolved cost. All 1,080 rows and complete-nine-population availability are reported.
stream: numpy.random.default_rng([20261015, 2, setting_index, batch_index]); draw_params(B), Poisson uniforms(B), binomial uniforms(B), then simulate_given(all accepted theta) in that order
ball: closed; float64 sqrt(sum((C[keep]/mad[keep] - q)^2)) <= radius; radius 0 means exact coordinate equality
assignment: longest-processing-time packing of expected seconds (or budgets) onto NWORKERS; ties by index
